scheme_name: Research Fellowship In Sciences For Meritorious Students
other_conditions: Candidate must be registered for Ph.D. in science subjects at a University with Potential for Excellence, Centre with Potential for Excellence, Centre of Advance Studies, or Department of Special Assistance identified by UGC.
benefits_summary: The scheme provides a monthly fellowship of ₹8,000 (plus an annual contingency) for up to five years, with leave benefits including maternity leave.
